objectives.label: Gear and flaps down, under 120 mph

then.message: Instructor: Torpedo qualification. Hold = for full throttle and take the Avenger off Tacloban.
Instructor: Hold her straight with Z and X, then ease back with S at 85 miles an hour.
Instructor: Airborne. Raise the gear with G.
Instructor: Turn east for the marker. Crow is anchored two thousand yards beyond it. Be below two thousand feet for the run.
Instructor: On the run. Open the bomb bay with B and steady the sight on Crow.
Instructor: Bay open. Press V to launch the torpedo. A hit or a miss both complete this practice run.
Instructor: Fish away. Crow is an unmanned range hulk and takes no damage. Close the bay with B, then return to Tacloban.
Instructor: Bay secure. Follow the arrow to the final.
Instructor: On the final. Gear down with G, flaps down with F, and slow below 120 miles an hour.
Instructor: Configuration checks. Put her down on the strip.

briefing.situation: Torpedo Qualification. Take a TBM-3 Avenger from Tacloban to the practice range in San Pedro Bay. Fly the marked run toward the unmanned USS Crow, open the bomb bay and launch one Mk 13 torpedo. A hit or a miss satisfies the exercise, and Crow cannot take damage in this mission. Close the bay, return to the final and land. Torpedo is the recommended loadout.

history.text: This mission is inspired by USS Crow's wartime service rather than a reconstruction of a particular exercise. The coastal minesweeper supported torpedo-plane training in Puget Sound as a target and torpedo-recovery vessel before an accidental practice torpedo sank her on 23 August 1943. The game's Crow is staged as an unmanned, already-damaged range hulk so pilots can practice safely.
